notes.title: Clothing Pack DLC second update!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

A brand new clothing pack including the 'Oriental Classics', 'Modern Occupations', and 'Panty Party' are now available! This DLC includes 48 new sets of clothes for 16 of our characters.

In addition to this, with this DLC, the gift shop boss will appear as a woman!

Come any try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048770/Legend_Of_Mercy_EX_clothing_pack_II__II/

notes.title: English Version Released!
notes.notes:
Hello players,

We are happy to announce that the English Version Language Patch has been officially released. We welcome all of you to play through the game in English!
When you launch the game, the language should be automatically set to English, but you can also manually choose your language in the Steam properties for the game.
One important thing to note is that the Chinese and English save files are not compatible with each other. If you played the Chinese version originally, you cannot continue your progress in the English version and vice-versa.
Legend of Mercy is our first game to be translated into English and because of our lack of experience, we took longer than expected to finish. If you find any bugs, please report them and we will try to fix them as soon as possible.
A very big thank you to the hard work of the translation team Sienna Plus Translations!

And finally, thank you to all the players who have been supporting us and waiting for the English version to be released. We hope everyone can have an exciting adventure in Legend of Mercy!
